name: Pilot Agreement
description: Short agreement for a time-limited paid or free product pilot, covering evaluation-only use, the pilot period and conversion to a full agreement.

coverPage.title: Pilot Agreement
coverPage.intro: This Pilot Agreement (the “Agreement”) consists of: (1) this Cover Page (“**Cover Page**”) and (2) the Common Paper Pilot Agreement Standard Terms (“**Standard Terms**”). Any modifications of the Standard Terms should be made on the Cover Page, which will control over conflicts with the Standard Terms.
coverPage.attestation: By signing this Cover Page, each party agrees to enter into this Agreement as of the Effective Date.
coverPage.attribution: Common Paper Pilot Agreement free to use under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

fields.label: Provider
fields.prompt: the provider's legal entity name, the signatory's name and title, and a notice address.

fields.label: Customer
fields.prompt: the customer's legal entity name, the signatory's name and title, and a notice address.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.prompt: the date the pilot starts, as yyyy-mm-dd.

fields.label: Pilot Period
fields.prompt: how long the pilot runs, such as "30 days from the Effective Date".

fields.label: Fees
fields.prompt: what the customer pays for the pilot, if anything. Pilots are often free.

fields.label: Notice Address
fields.prompt: where notices under the agreement are sent, if different from the signature block.

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.prompt: the full name of the US state whose law governs, such as "Delaware". Always a state, never a country or a city.

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.prompt: the courts that hear disputes, such as "the state and federal courts located in New Castle County, Delaware".

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.prompt: the most either party can be made to pay, such as "$10,000".
